content: Discourse public JSON: append .json — /latest.json (live-verified anonymous on meta.discourse.org, 30 topics with posts_count, reply_count, like_count, created_at, slug), /top.json?period=daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|yearly|all, /search.json?q=, /t/{id}.json detail, /categories.json. Api-Key headers only needed for private/login_required instances; anonymous 429s possible — existing retry/stale fallback covers it.
